tests.result: verify_log keys events by exact target/class/method; only the ordered two-event sequence started, passed contributes to passed. Duplicate starts/passes, reversed order, failures, skips, unknown events, missing starts, missing terminal events and omitted methods all produce invalid entries and failed status.

Interleaved methods preserve individual event order. Foreign targets or classes cannot supply selected events. Fullmatch rejects unfamiliar case syntax or trailing event text. Parameterized names, nested/qualified class paths and slash identities are unsupported and fail closed when presented as Test Case lines; current selected XCTest declarations use plain parameterless methods.

Report defaults to failed, preserves expected/unstarted inventory on log-read failure, writes failure reports in finally, and does not emit success on verification failure. A started but interrupted method remains started, has no passed entry, and retains its incomplete event sequence in invalid; wholly omitted methods remain unstarted.

Inspected assertions for valid single/interleaved sequences; 11 invalid event sequences; foreign targets; malformed case lines; missing, failed and skipped inventory categories; preservation of event line numbers; replacement of prior passing report on failure; unreadable log; CLI preflight and unknown inventory failures; nested source directories; duplicate classes and shard assignments. Tests assert report contents and lack of false success output, not merely exception existence.
